decisions.reason: The shipped row linked to Morriss, Christakou, & van Reekum (2016; 10.1016/j.biopsycho.2016.05.001), which is cited only as background, whereas the study actually replicated is Morriss, Macdonald, & van Reekum (2016; 10.1371/journal.pone.0154494).

decisions.quote:
Taken together, and although the direct replication failed, 
our results provide evidence at the conceptual level that com-
pared  to  lower  IU  individuals,  higher  IU  individuals  may 
show  greater  threat  generalization  and  delayed  learning  of 
threat  cue  pairings.
decisions.reason: The shipped outcome ('failed') reflects only the direct replication, whereas the paper aggregates one failed direct replication and two supporting conceptual replications of the same original study into a mixed overall outcome.
